edges.mechanism: In rats BPC-157 shortened bleeding time and limited thrombocytopenia under heparin or warfarin; FDA noted aPTT shortening (rats) and prolongation (dogs) in 28-day studies. This could oppose anticoagulation or perturb aPTT/INR; direction in humans unknown.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies and FDA nonclinical review; no human data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: In rats BPC-157 restored arachidonic-acid-induced platelet aggregation inhibited by aspirin and reduced aspirin-associated bleeding; it could theoretically blunt antiplatelet effect.
edges.evidence: Rodent aggregometry/bleeding studies only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: In rats BPC-157 counteracted clopidogrel and cilostazol inhibition of ADP-, collagen- and arachidonic-acid-induced aggregation (possible loss of antiplatelet efficacy); it also reduced clopidogrel gastric injury.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 causes endothelium-dependent, NO-mediated vasorelaxation (rat aorta via Src-Caveolin-1-eNOS; human internal mammary artery rings); additive hypotension with NO donors or PDE5 inhibitors is theoretically possible.
edges.evidence: Ex vivo/mechanistic only; no clinical interaction data

edges.mechanism: Rodent studies show BPC-157 counteracting haloperidol catalepsy and supersensitivity, neuroleptic-induced QTc prolongation and vascular occlusion-like syndromes; it may alter dopaminergic drug effects.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies, mostly from one group; clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 blocked amphetamine-induced stereotypy and reversed amphetamine-induced occlusion-like vascular syndrome in rodents; it may modulate amphetamine response.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 altered regional brain 5-HT synthesis and attenuated pargyline + L-tryptophan serotonin syndrome in rats; pharmacodynamic interaction with serotonergic drugs is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 counteracted haloperidol-enhanced morphine analgesia in mice (dopamine-opioid interaction); effect on opioid analgesia in humans unknown.
edges.evidence: Single mouse study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 is a weak reversible competitive acetylcholinesterase inhibitor in vitro; additive cholinergic effect is theoretical.
edges.evidence: In vitro enzyme study only

edges.mechanism: In rats BPC-157 counteracted high-dose lithium toxicity (vascular/multiorgan failure); not evidence of benefit or safety in human lithium therapy or poisoning.
edges.evidence: Rodent toxicity model; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: In rats BPC-157 abrogated magnesium-overdose hypermagnesemia and related disturbances; human relevance unknown.
edges.evidence: Rodent toxicity model; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 opposed methylprednisolone-impaired Achilles tendon-to-bone and muscle healing in rats.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies only; no human data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 counteracted NSAID (celecoxib, diclofenac and others) gastrointestinal, liver and brain lesions in rodents.
edges.evidence: Rodent studies and same-group reviews; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Commonly co-injected; a rechallenge-positive FAERS case of diffuse hyperpigmentation and gingival darkening involved a research-only BPC-157/TB-500 blend; a 2026 rat study found no additive tendon benefit; both are unapproved and prohibited in sport.
edges.evidence: One FAERS report, one rat study, review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Pro-angiogenic actions (VEGFR2-Akt-eNOS, FBXO22-BACH1) raise a theoretical tumour-promotion concern; no carcinogenicity studies exist.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic/preclinical data, expert reviews and FDA review; theoretical, very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Only one IM rat embryo-fetal study (no malformations up to 4 mg/kg); no full reproductive-cycle or human data.
edges.evidence: Single animal study; no human data

edges.mechanism: aPTT changes in rats and dogs and effects on bleeding and platelet aggregation in rodents; human haemostatic effects uncharacterized.
edges.evidence: FDA nonclinical review and rodent studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 is named under WADA S0 Non-approved substances, prohibited at all times in and out of competition.
edges.evidence: Official WADA Prohibited List (2026)

edges.mechanism: BPC-157 and its metabolites are detectable in urine (LOD 0.1 ng/mL) and in dried blood spots; use produces true-positive doping findings.
edges.evidence: Validated analytical methods

edges.mechanism: 28-day animal studies showed aPTT shortening (rats) and prolongation (dogs); no human data.
edges.evidence: FDA re-analysis of animal toxicology

edges.mechanism: FDA flagged raised ALT, glucose and triglycerides in 28-day animal studies; the IV pilot (n=2) found no liver-test change.
edges.evidence: Animal toxicology and a 2-person pilot; very low certainty
